steps.why: It measures what the plant actually does with each colour, which is why it is called the action spectrum.
common_mistakes: Saying it plots absorption. That is the OTHER spectrum.
Leaving out 'at different wavelengths'. Both graphs run against wavelength.
steps.memory_tip: Action means what the plant DOES with the light.
